details:
AstroMed is a local AI health-support app designed for astronaut crews, who may have limited access to medical help during a mission. Crew members can create individual profiles, log vital signs, report symptoms, and review their own health history. Flask handles the app’s crew-facing features, while SQLite stores records separately for each crew member. FastAPI provides the project’s retrieval and copilot services.

For a symptom report, the local Qwen model uses the crew member’s symptoms, recent vitals, and prior reports to generate a cautious preliminary assessment. The app searches indexed NASA documents separately and includes follow-up steps only when it can verify them against a passage, keeping model-generated assessments distinct from NASA-sourced guidance. The project uses Python, Flask, FastAPI, SQLite, Ollama, ChromaDB, and a browser-based frontend. AstroMed aims to offer private, organized crew-health support and make relevant mission information easier to find.
